provenance.canonical-source: apps/v4/registry/new-york-v4/ui/combobox.tsx — sixteen exported parts, over @base-ui/react's Combobox primitive (external, unvendored — package.json dependency "@base-ui/react": "1.6.0", no node_modules/@base-ui/ anywhere under 3-source/). Every STYLE value below comes from this file plus apps/v4/registry/new-york-v4/ui/input-group.tsx, which ComboboxInput composes for its own trigger chrome (InputGroup/InputGroupAddon/InputGroupButton/InputGroupInput). See COMBOBOX-MATRIX.md's own scope note for the real, sourced correction to this build's starting hypothesis (shadcn ships a dedicated primitive now, not only the older compose-Command-in-a-Popover pattern).
provenance.field-bg: InputGroup's own class `dark:bg-input/30`, no light-mode background class at all — transparent in light, identical derivation to select.shadcn.json's own field-bg (though select ALSO composes a dark hover variant; combobox's InputGroup does not — see no-hover provenance below).
provenance.fg: ComboboxInput composes InputGroupInput -> Input, which sets no text-colour class; the ambient --foreground applies, identical to select's own fg.
provenance.fg-secondary: --muted-foreground. THREE consumers: ComboboxLabel's text-muted-foreground, ComboboxEmpty's text-muted-foreground, and the placeholder attribute's own ambient colour (Input's own ::placeholder rule, not overridden here).
provenance.border-base: InputGroup's own class `border border-input` -> --input, identical token chain to select's own border-base.
provenance.popup-border: ComboboxContent's own class `ring-1 ring-foreground/10` — a REAL, SOURCED DIVERGENCE from select's shadcn popup, which uses a bare `border` utility -> --border. combobox.tsx composes a RING here instead of a border utility; --foreground/10% resolves to the SAME numeric alpha in both modes (oklch(...)/10%), which is why this slot is recorded modeInvariant unlike select's own popup-border, whose --border token genuinely differs by mode.
provenance.popup-bg / popup-fg: ComboboxPrimitive.Popup's own class `bg-popover text-popover-foreground` -> --popover / --popover-foreground, identical to select's own popup-bg/-fg.
provenance.accent-bg / accent-fg: ComboboxItem's own class `data-highlighted:bg-accent data-highlighted:text-accent-foreground` -> --accent / --accent-foreground, the SAME mechanism select's shadcn column documents (base-ui's own internal highlighted-index concept driving the data attribute, not real DOM focus — see COMBOBOX-MATRIX.md behavior.focus-model).
provenance.focus: InputGroup's own class `has-[[data-slot=input-group-control]:focus-visible]:border-ring has-[...]:ring-[3px] has-[...]:ring-ring/50` -> --ring. The has-[] selector reacts to InputGroupInput's own data-slot="input-group-control" attribute receiving :focus-visible — confirmed by reading input-group.tsx directly.
provenance.danger: InputGroup's own class `has-[[data-slot][aria-invalid=true]]:border-destructive has-[...]:ring-destructive/20 dark:has-[...]:ring-destructive/40` -> --destructive, same two-alpha structure as select's own danger slot.
provenance.shadow-color / popup-shadow: InputGroup's own class `shadow-xs`; ComboboxContent's own class `shadow-md`. Same values and same [R] Tailwind-default caveat select.shadcn.json's own popup-shadow entry records (package not vendored).
provenance.radius-control / radius-popup / radius-o: InputGroup's own class `rounded-md` (trigger); ComboboxContent's own class `rounded-md` (popup); ComboboxItem's own class `rounded-sm` (option) — identical values to select's own radius family.
provenance.type-body / type-group-label: ComboboxItem's own class `text-sm`; ComboboxLabel's own class `text-xs` with no weight utility — identical values to select's own type-body/type-group-label.
provenance.no-hover-on-trigger: CONFIRMED ABSENCE: neither InputGroup's own className (read in full) nor combobox.tsx's own ComboboxInput/ComboboxTrigger className strings carry any `hover:` utility of any kind — a real, sourced CONTRAST with select.shadcn.json's own field-bg-hover row (select's trigger DOES react to the pointer, in dark mode only). combobox's trigger is inert to hover in both modes, matching shadcn's plain Input's own no-hover finding (INPUT-MATRIX.md finding 5) rather than select's own exception to it.
provenance.no-item-aligned: ComboboxContent's own destructured `side = "bottom"`, `align = "start"` defaults — no item-aligned/overlay mode exists for this primitive at all, unlike select's Radix-based Content, whose default IS item-aligned. See COMBOBOX-MATRIX.md Finding 3.
provenance.anchor-width-popup: ComboboxContent's own class `w-(--anchor-width)` — base-ui's Positioner publishes this custom property as the measured anchor's own width, and the popup is tied to it BY DEFAULT (unlike select's Radix Content, whose min-w-[8rem] fixed floor applies unless position="popper"). A real, sourced structural divergence recorded on style.popup.min-width.
provenance.duration-100-animation: ComboboxContent's own class `duration-100` alongside `data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-open:zoom-in-95` — a real, sourced 100ms duration utility SET EXPLICITLY on this component, unlike select's shadcn popup (which relies on tw-animate-css's own undeclared 150ms default with no duration utility of its own). Recorded as [S] for the number (a literal Tailwind duration-100 utility, not a package default), [R] only for the easing curve (still tw-animate-css's own ease-out, unvendored).
provenance.clear-and-trigger-buttons: ComboboxClear/ComboboxTrigger both compose InputGroupButton size="icon-xs" variant="ghost" — a 16px icon box (Button's own size-icon-xs class family, reused rather than re-derived from button.shadcn.json), no border, no background at rest.
provenance.empty-state: ComboboxEmpty's own class `py-2 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground`, shown via `group-data-empty/combobox-content:flex` when base-ui's own internal empty-items state is true.

structure.trigger.source: combobox.tsx ComboboxInput renders ComboboxPrimitive.Input via InputGroupInput -> a real <input> element

structure.indicator.note: structurally always a full border — InputGroup's own chrome, no underline mechanism of any kind anywhere in combobox.tsx or input-group.tsx

structure.toggle-button.source: combobox.tsx ComboboxTrigger, data-slot="combobox-trigger", a single static ChevronDownIcon, never swapped

structure.clear-button.source: combobox.tsx ComboboxClear, data-slot="combobox-clear", opt-in via ComboboxInput's own showClear prop (default false), holds an XIcon

structure.empty-state.source: combobox.tsx ComboboxEmpty — a real, dedicated part with no equivalent in Salt or M3

structure.selected-marker.source: combobox.tsx ComboboxItem renders ComboboxItemIndicator holding a CheckIcon, absolutely positioned right-2, pr-8 reserved on every item

structure.popup-anchor.source: combobox.tsx ComboboxContent side="bottom" (default), align="start" (default) — see the no-item-aligned provenance entry

behavior.pointer-activates-option.note: [R] — data-highlighted styling implies pointer-move highlighting, not independently confirmable at the event level (unvendored)

behavior.readonly-suppresses-popup.note: ComboboxInput's own destructured props are only disabled/showTrigger/showClear — no readOnly prop exists

behavior.multiselect.note: DECLARED OUT OF SCOPE — see COMBOBOX-MATRIX.md scope note

prop.validation-status.note: a single boolean (aria-invalid), not an enum

prop.disabled.source: combobox.tsx ComboboxInput disabled = false destructured, forwarded to InputGroupInput -> Input's own disabled styling

prop.read-only.note: CONFIRMED ABSENT — no readOnly prop on ComboboxInput

prop.placeholder.source: combobox.tsx ComboboxInput placeholder prop passed straight to the native <input>

style.trigger.padding.source: InputGroup composes InputGroupInput, which inherits Input's own horizontal padding via the has-[>[data-align]] rules; combobox.tsx's own ComboboxInput sets no extra padding class

style.trigger.cursor.note: no cursor utility on the input itself; the browser's native text-input cursor applies, which IS text — same rendered result as Salt's explicit token, but shadcn declares nothing

style.trigger.transition.note: property list [S]; duration/easing [R] — Tailwind defaults, package not vendored

style.trigger.background@hover.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — see no-hover-on-trigger provenance; a real contrast with select's own dark-mode hover

value.box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring-current) var(--ring-alpha-current), transparent), 0 1px 2px 0 var(--shadow-color)

style.trigger.focus.source: input-group.tsx InputGroup class has-[...]:ring-[3px] has-[...]:ring-ring/50, layered after shadow-xs the same way select.shadcn.json's own style.trigger.focus documents

style.trigger.background@disabled.note: one blanket opacity via the composed Input's own disabled styling

style.trigger.disabled.source: combobox.tsx ComboboxInput forwards disabled to InputGroupInput -> Input, which carries disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed

style.value.placeholder.source: the composed Input's own ::placeholder rule -> text-muted-foreground

style.toggle-button.size.source: combobox.tsx ComboboxTrigger's own [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4 rule, matching the chevron

style.clear-button.size.source: combobox.tsx ComboboxClear composes InputGroupButton size="icon-xs" — see the clear-and-trigger-buttons provenance entry

style.popup.border.note: a RING utility (ring-1 ring-foreground/10), not the bare `border` utility select's own popup uses — see the popup-border provenance entry

style.popup.min-width.note: a REAL structural divergence from select's shadcn column: this popup is tied to the anchor's own width by default (w-(--anchor-width)), not a fixed 8rem floor — see the anchor-width-popup provenance entry

style.popup.animation.note: 100ms IS [S] (a literal duration-100 utility); ease-out is [R] — see the duration-100-animation provenance entry
style.popup.animation.source: combobox.tsx ComboboxContent class duration-100 data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-open:zoom-in-95

style.option.padding.source: combobox.tsx ComboboxItem class py-1.5 pr-8 pl-2

style.option.background@hover.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — highlight is data-highlighted, not hover:

style.option.selected.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — marked only by the checkmark, see structure.selected-marker

style.selected-marker.box.source: combobox.tsx ComboboxItemIndicator span class absolute right-2 flex size-4, holding a size-4 CheckIcon
